Use this skill when the user asks about MTG cards, wants to search for cards by name, type, color, mana cost, oracle text, set, or any other card attribute. Also use for getting card images, prices, rulings, legality information, or random cards. Triggers include mentions of MTG, Magic, Magic: The Gathering, card names, deck building questions, or requests for card information.
